name: SoftwareSuggest

sources.title: SoftwareSuggest vendor page — Create a Free Listing form and value-added services

conditions: Consumer email providers are not supported — you must register with a business-domain email (gmail.com, outlook.com, hotmail.com etc. are rejected)
requirements: Vendor listing for a real software product or software service
Form requires: company head office, number of employees (banded: Freelancer to 10,000+), number of customers (banded: 1-25 to 500+), and a software/service category
Account setup is completed via an emailed link after the initial form
preparation: A work email on the company domain
Company head-office location, employee band, customer-count band
Correct product category from their ~1,500-category taxonomy
Product collateral for the full profile (features, pricing, screenshots) once portal access arrives
workflow: Fill 'List Your Product — It's Free': company head office, employee count, customer count, category, business email
Submit; an email with a link completes account setup
Log into the vendor portal and complete the product profile for listing
Listing goes live after their review/onboarding process
watchFor: Business-email gate is enforced at the form level — consumer mailboxes fail immediately

The vendor page heavily promotes paid 'Value Added Services' (PPC, Marketing Qualified Leads, Premium Listing, branded content, sponsorships) and pushes 'Request a Call Back' — expect sales outreach after listing
Separate User Login vs Vendor Login — use the vendor path
countsAsLive: The product appears in SoftwareSuggest's category listings with a profile page users can review and compare.
unknowns: Review/approval latency for new vendor listings
Whether outbound vendor links are dofollow
